definitions.explanation: The act of receiving or welcoming someone.
Going to get someone from a place.

examples.japanese: {温|あたた}かい{迎え|むかえ}だった。
{駅|えき}で{迎え|むかえ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I was welcomed at the station.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{直接|ちょくせつ}{迎え|むかえ}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: The president came to greet us in person.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{社員|しゃいん}を{迎え|むかえ}る{準備|じゅんび}をしている。
examples.english: We are preparing to welcome the new employee.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{空港|くうこう}で{有名|ゆうめい}な{歌手|かしゅ}を{迎え|むかえ}るために{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: A large crowd gathered at the airport to welcome the famous singer.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}まで{迎え|むかえ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'll go pick you up at the airport.

examples.japanese: {お迎|むか}えが{来|き}ましたよ。
{子供|こども}を{学校|がっこう}に{迎え|むかえ}に{行|い}かなければならない。
examples.english: I have to go pick up my child from school.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}が{駅|えき}まで{迎え|むかえ}に{来|き}てくれたので、{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}わずに{着|つ}けた。
examples.english: My friend came to pick me up at the station, so I arrived without getting lost.

notes: From the verb {迎|むか}える. Often used with に{行|い}く/{来|く}る for "go/come to pick up."
